title: Identify actionable inbox messages
question: What action should the recipient take according to this message?

criteria.reply: Recipient is explicitly asked to answer, decide or confirm
criteria.task: Recipient is assigned work, without a required message reply
criteria.none: Informational, cancelled, already resolved or addressed to someone else
criteria.clarify: An action is requested but essential identity or scope is ambiguous

benefit: Process a mailbox batch without dumping every message into Codex.
